method: Recomputed from frozen data only: v4 Month Jian = branch of the last JPL Jie whose clock-v1 civil ms <= floor(instant ms); target from calendar-rule-extraction-v3 lookup; day operands from the v3 fixture (instants unchanged, so civil dates unchanged). Expected iff the v3 instant lies 0 < d <= 1000 ms before the v4 Jie that opens the v3 month and the 3B.4.4A audit diff records the same v4 values.
